newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia '96 beet output revised up to 15.1 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia '96 beet output revised up to 15.1 mln T.

text.p: Russia's 1996 sugar beet output has been revised up to 15.1 million tonnes from 14.9 million tonnes, according to State Statistics Committee figures released on Thursday covering output on all farms.
The committee, which did not say whether the figures were preliminary or final, also said it had revised up Russia's 1996 sunflower seed output to 2.5 million tonnnes from 2.4 million tonnes.
Russia's total sugar beet output last year was 18.3 million tonnes, the committee said. Government forecasts earlier this year had targeted a 1996 harvest of 16.0 million tonnes.
Total sunseed output last year was nearly 4.2 million tonnes. Officials had targeted a harvest this year of around 3.0 million tonnes.
Independent agricultural specialists say that with about 13 percent of Russian sunflower seeds grown on small, private farms, total output is difficult to calculate but may reach 3.1 million tonnes.
The committee's figures for sunflower seed and sugar beet output included production on private farms.
Around four percent of the beet harvest is grown on private farms.
